review_evidence: README describes WAST-to-Lean-to-binary parsing, a Lean WebAssembly runtime and related Wasm tooling.

A complete scan of all 22 Lean files found 370 declaration-style lines. Wasm/Wast/AST.lean gives a detailed typed representation of WebAssembly value types, locals/globals, function types and control/numeric operations, with parser/encoding/engine modules around it.

Although the snapshot is implementation-oriented and has no theorem/lemma declarations, its explicit WebAssembly syntax and execution-facing structures are reusable object-language/formal-interface prior art; FILTER-002 therefore favors retention.
summary: Reviewed Wasm.lean and retain its formal WebAssembly/WAST syntax, parser and runtime representation as reusable language-specification interfaces.
